data.title: Goldman Sachs discloses over $1B in spot Bitcoin ETF holdings
data.description: Goldman Sachs now holds more than $1 billion in Bitcoin exposure. The bank's spot Bitcoin ETF holdings reached approximately $1.283 billion as of September 30, 2026, according to its Form 13F filing with the SEC.That figure represents a 121% jump from around $580 million at the end of the second qu…
